newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 22.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL
-------- COMMENTS - Bunker levels on Wednesday eased

following a further slide in cargo levels, traders said. A major quoted 380-cst at $90-$92 but an independent was heard to have sold a parcel at $88-$89 late Wednesday. Despite falling prices, demand remained thin with regional prices in South Korea, Fujairah still firm. Traders said shipowners were sidelined, confident of a further price fall.
